arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS superhero_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS distinct_superhero_count,
    COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS nonnull_weight_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(s.weight_kg) = 'integer' THEN 1 END) AS integer_weight_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN s.weight_kg <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS nonpositive_weight_count,
    MIN(s.weight_kg) AS min_weight_kg,
    MAX(s.weight_kg) AS max_weight_kg
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';
